subject: 243 Mystic Avenue Life Science Building
overview: The board conducted an informal review of a proposed eight-story lab building at 243 Mystic Avenue and evaluated a draft of new storefront design guidelines. Members also approved minutes from three previous meetings and discussed the upcoming representative vacancy on the Community Preservation Committee.

items.title: 243 Mystic Avenue Lab Building Informal Review
items.summary: The board reviewed a proposal for an eight-story speculative life science building, focusing on its 150-foot height, automated parking system, and potential impacts on the surrounding neighborhood and Mystic Avenue corridor.

items.title: Storefront Design Guidelines Review
items.summary: Yvette Niwa presented draft design guidelines for the Medford Storefronts Facade Improvement Program, aimed at providing aesthetic and regulatory standards for local businesses seeking facade grants.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes from January 18, February 1, and February 15, 2023, with minor corrections to the January and February 15 records.

items.title: Staff Updates and Committee Vacancy
items.summary: Staff discussed potential April meeting cancellations, and the board addressed the requirement to appoint a successor to the Community Preservation Committee as Christy Dowd's term expires.
